decisions.reason: Encrypted communication is very close to a mature software-security firm's existing knowledge base, so early market feedback can likely be absorbed and used to improve the product rather than abandon it.
A mobile PDF digital signature function fits strongly with established capabilities in secure workflows and business software, making commercial refinement relatively low risk.
A multi-layer end-to-end security architecture is highly aligned with the firm's core technical competence and gives strong scope for cumulative learning and further development.
The secure email-to-app delivery robot is related to the firm's security and integration know-how, though its narrower use case makes discontinuation somewhat more likely if adoption is weak.

A QR-code-based hardware signature token reaches beyond a software consultancy's strongest absorptive base into hardware support and device operations, raising the chance the firm reallocates resources elsewhere.

A payment network security compliance suite is adjacent to the firm's security expertise and can benefit from learning effects, but its specialised regulatory domain makes it less secure than the core communication products.
